adjudication.rationale: The diff shows at line 22 of groups_controller.rb: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` which accepts any user-provided limit value without an upper bound. A malicious user could pass an extremely large limit value (e.g., limit=1000000) to force the server to load and serialize a massive number of user records from a large group, potentially causing memory exhaustion or denial of service. This is a real security/performance vulnerability introduced by this code.
